title: Construction and cohomology of raw rational module realization
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$. Module sheaves, sheaf tensor products, derived categories and cohomology are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,A)$ for the completed integral category including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and $Q:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=\mathcal C_X[1/\varpi]$ for its raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. A rational module sheaf is constructible when on a finite locally closed stratification it is pro-etale locally finite free [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module]. Put $F_X(K)=E_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K$. The formulas for the induced functor are $J_X(QK)=F_X(K)$ and $J_X(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_X(f)$. The quotient projections identify $B_X$ with $U\mapsto C(|U|,A)$ and its sheaf localization $E_X$ with $U\mapsto C(|U|,E)$, preserving finite-quotient constant sections and locally closed restriction [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction]. The functor $F_X:D(B_X)\to D(E_X)$ induced by scalar localization is exact on module sheaves and triangulated on derived categories. It sends $\mathcal C_X$ to the full subcategory of bounded objects with constructible cohomology and factors through a well-defined $E$-linear triangulated functor $J_X:\mathcal R_X\to D(E_X)$ with the displayed object and fraction formulas. For every integer $r$ there is a natural isomorphism $\mathcal H^r(F_XK)\cong E_X\otimes_{B_X}\mathcal H^r(K)$. On a stratum where integral cohomology has model $B_S\otimes_A N$ for finitely presented $N$, this is $E_S\otimes_E(E\otimes_A N)$, a finite free rational model. Here the stratified-perfect description and closure of $\mathcal C_X$ are those of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]; no flatness of $N$ is assumed. No full faithfulness or essential surjectivity is asserted.

proof.text: Construct i as completedIso followed by the inverse continuous completion isomorphism. Construct each finite coefficient isomorphism by the normalized level constant comparison, the uniquely normalized ULift quotient equivalence and the continuous finite quotient comparison. Limit projection formulas prove the integral normalization. The finiteRingComparison and pbcLevelConstantComparison units identify function scalars with sheafified constants, giving finite normalization. Comparing the scalar maps at every finite projection and using constant-sheaf adjunction gives the scalar square. Continuous localization and normalized immersion restriction supply the other coefficient fields; extensionality of continuous functions identifies the ambient inclusion with the actual coefficient map.

proof.text: Apply the completed-presentation localization transport with this scalar-normalized i. Use the canonical constant-section module action. The sheafification-adjunction unit identifies its field scalars with rationalModuleConstantMap, so its linearity, exactness, cohomology and fixed raw fraction data fill the corresponding realization fields.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2; Definition 6.8.10; Proposition 6.8.11(3); construction of Proposition 6.8.14(2)

proof.text: The integral characterization gives bounds a,b and integral stratified finitely presented cohomology. Exact extension sends zero cohomology outside [a,b] to zero. The natural cohomology isomorphism therefore gives the same bounds for the prescribed derived extension. Apply ordinary local-model transport to each integral cohomology sheaf and transport its finite local freeness along the inverse image of this cohomology isomorphism. Apply its ordinary model formula to N; finite presentation makes E tensor_A N finite dimensional and every field module is free. These construct all remaining fields.

reviewed_lean.note: Item JSON differs from live only in the new lean record; the 12 dependency node files equal live; lean.statement is verbatim. Hypotheses (noetherian, finite dimension, l invertible) are not stronger than the node. integralIso/finiteIso are pinned by the constant-section and projection normalizations, and localization/inclusion by the recorded predicates. F_X = pbcDerivedExtend along the pinned map, with exactness, triangulation and a natural cohomology iso for every r. Constructibility: bounds plus a finite locally closed stratification with IsFiniteLocallyFree inverse images, matching the node's definition. J is determined by literal object equality and the fraction formula (n=0 gives J∘Q=F); its E-action is fixed by scalar_normalization and the source action by pbcRationalLinear. The models clause covers finitely presented N with finite free E⊗N. The three helpers are canonical and docstringed. Edge cases and universes are OK. No recompile (instruction); the report records a clean compile. Advisories: the Second reading section disclaims a reading under the direct-delivery policy (precedents Q150 and Q18 PASSed); J.CommShift is free; the cohomology iso is unpinned; some declarations have owners outside stmt_deps; the stratum transport of the model clause is left to a proof dependency.
